Dylan / Team —

Thanks for the heads up. A couple of accounting points to confirm before we process anything:

1) Treatment: Promotional credit of $5,000 should be recorded as a contra‑revenue item (promo credits). We typically issue a credit memo (CM) and then apply it as an invoice offset against the outstanding invoice unless there is a specific customer requirement to keep a separate entry.

2) GL / metadata: Please confirm the GL code — we will use PromoCredits‑4010 and tag the credit memo with Deal ID HUBSPOT‑98765 and reason note "Trial extension — POC delay".

3) Timing: If Waypoint prefers the offset applied immediately against INV‑2026‑045, Billing will create CM and apply it to the invoice; that will reduce the receivable. If the invoice has already been paid, we will issue a credit memo for future offset.

Marcus / Marissa — can you prepare the credit memo draft and confirm whether CM should be CM‑2026‑1023 (next available sequence) and advise on any tax treatment (I believe this is non‑taxable in our standard promo flow).

Samantha — please confirm INV‑2026‑045 and whether payment has been made so we can choose the appropriate path.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
